name: humanizer-en
title_zh: 按维基百科「AI 写作痕迹」清单逐条删的改稿器
tagline_zh: 你交上去的稿子被说「一看就是 AI 写的」，问题往往不在内容，而在排比三连、破折号。
tagline_en: Told your draft 'reads like AI'? The tell is rarely the ideas — it's rule-of-three, em dashes, -ing filler.
desc_en: Remove signs of AI-generated writing from text. Use when editing or reviewing text to make it sound more natural and human-written. Based on Wikipedia's comprehensive "Signs of AI writing" guide. Detects and fixes patterns including: inflated symbolism, promotional language, superficial -ing analyses, vague attributions, em dash overuse, rule of three, AI vocabulary words, passive voice, negative
why_zh: 它不靠「读起来顺不顺」的语感，而是有一份可核对的清单：膨胀的象征意义、宣传腔、肤浅的 -ing 分析。
why_en: Not vibes-based. It works from a checkable list — inflated symbolism, promotional tone, superficial -ing analysis, vague.
limit_zh: 只做英文文本，中文稿子它按英文规则判会误伤；清单是启发式的，正经学术写作、法律文书里合法的被动和排比也会被标出来。
limit_en: English text only — Chinese drafts get false positives. The list is heuristic: legitimate passive voice and parallelism in academic or legal writing.
title_en: Rewrites text against Wikipedia's Signs of AI Writing list
